content:
WebSocket消息权限补全：
1. terminal_close → terminal:create权限校验 (app.py L997-1012)
2. terminal_session_input → terminal:create权限校验 (app.py L1022-1037)
3. file_upload → file:upload权限校验 (app.py L1057-1073)
4. BUILTIN_GROUPS新增file:upload权限至sys-operator、sys-developer组
5. 终端操作统一用terminal:create权限（创建/关闭/输入）
6. 文件上传独立用file:upload权限
7. system用户跳过权限检查
8. 无权限时：terminal类返回terminal_error，file_upload返回file_upload_response(success=False)
9. terminal_create已有权限校验(L953-968)
10. 其他消息类型(sync_request/input_result/confirm_result/terminal_input/terminal_resize/manual_interrupt/get_status/chat_*)无需权限校验
